title: Rate Sheet Footnote: Loan-to-Value Add-On to the Builder Extended Rate Lock Upfront Fee
content:
High-leverage loans carry added points on the upfront fee percent of a Builder Extended Rate Lock.

**Footnote.** The fee loan-to-value is the loan amount on the lock divided by the Home Purchase Agreement's contract price, as a percent. Above 85 it adds 0.125 percentage points to the upfront fee percent; above 80 up to 85 it adds 0.0625 percentage points; otherwise nothing. The points are added to the upfront fee percent before it is applied to the loan amount on the lock.

| Fee loan-to-value | Added to the upfront fee percent |
|---|---|
| 80 or below | nothing |
| above 80, up to and including 85 | 0.0625 percentage points |
| above 85 | 0.125 percentage points |

## Cases (hypothetical inputs, contract price USD 500000.00)

| Loan amount on the lock | Fee loan-to-value | Added |
|---|---|---|
| USD 400000.00 | 80 | nothing |
| USD 400500.00 | 80.1 | 0.0625 |
| USD 425000.00 | 85 | 0.0625 |
| USD 427500.00 | 85.5 | 0.125 |

The loan amount is the one on the lock record as it stands when the fee is fixed.
